patches.name: Enable Google Rambler
patches.description: Exposes options to enable Google Rambler on any phone.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Enable unlimited photo exports from captured RAW frames, remove the 5-second video recording limit, enable pro tools, apply patched MotionCam branding, and spoof the installer source as Google Play. Installer source spoofing adapted from Morphe.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Pro tethering and disables purchase actions in the shop.
